payload.title: Mark generate_lead as a GA4 key event
payload.description:
As Ryan, I want generate_lead flagged as a key event in GA4 so that real leads are counted as conversions in reports.

Steps (Ryan): GA4 property for G-31SC26SDGX, Admin > Data display > Events, toggle 'Mark as key event' for generate_lead (the event must have been received at least once; the verification issue produces it).

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: Key event configured
  Given generate_lead has been received by GA4
  When Ryan opens Admin > Data display > Events
  Then generate_lead is shown with the key event toggle on
Scenario: First real lead counted
  Given generate_lead is a key event
  When the first real lead submits the engage form and receives a 202 receipt
  Then GA4 reports show one key event count for generate_lead

Dependencies: the live verification issue (the event must exist in GA4 first).
